entry.name: Lancero acolchado
entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game: a West African heavy cavalryman on a pale grey warhorse standing still, all four hooves flat on the ground, legs straight, head up, tail hanging clear of the ground. The rider sits upright in a thick quilted cream cotton war-coat and an indigo turban wound over a quilted cap, a long lance held straight up. The horse wears thick quilted cotton armour in broad indigo-blue and cream stripes over its body and neck, ending above the knees. Stylized painted realism, chunky shapes, hard edges, flat faces. One solid model, isolated, no ground, no text.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Horse coat pale grey (#B8B2A6), dark hooves. Quilted horse armour in broad stripes of saturated indigo blue (#2E3F8F) and cream (#E3D8BE). Rider's war-coat cream (#E3D8BE), turban saturated indigo blue (#2E3F8F). Leather dark brown (#4A3526). Lance iron grey (#8A8C8E). Skin deep brown (#5A3A28). No text or logos.
